We had been there a little late in an evening apparently it we were in a dark open space with candle lights around , ambience was lovely. Not much choices on menu. We had a chicken charcoal steak and juice.  One turn down is with the price they are charging quantity is too low especially on juices and all. Apart from that it's a deal.
